sources.title: Buccaneers at Lions: Initial injury report for Week 11
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers returned from their bye week and began preparations for their Week 11 matchup against the Detroit Lions on Wednesday, with much of the attention surrounding the health of quarterback Baker Mayfield. Tampa Bay listed six players on its initial injury report, including two who did not participate in practice. Mayfield (foot/right thumb) […]
